title: Warranty and Safety Recall Coverage — Precedence Among Coverages on One Vehicle
content:
# Precedence Among Coverages on One Vehicle

## Clauses

1. **One coverage of a type per vehicle.** Under the Warranty and Safety Recall Coverage, a vehicle that already has an active coverage of a coverage type cannot be registered for that type again. Whether the vehicle already has such a coverage is read from the company's coverage records — the vehicle, the coverage type and the coverage's status — before the registration is made.
2. **Exactly one coverage pays.** When more than one coverage on a vehicle covers the same failure, exactly one pays, in this order — Safety Recall Remedy Coverage for a recalled part, then Factory Basic Limited Warranty, then Factory Powertrain Limited Warranty or Federal Emissions Performance Warranty for their components, then Certified Pre-Owned Powertrain Warranty, then Kessler Used Vehicle Limited Warranty.
3. **One deductible.** Only the paying coverage's deductible applies.
4. **No paying coverage.** A failure no in-force coverage pays is customer pay or falls to a service contract under that product's own terms.

## Precedence table

| Rank | Coverage that pays when it covers the failure |
|---|---|
| 1 | Safety Recall Remedy Coverage, for a recalled part |
| 2 | Factory Basic Limited Warranty |
| 3 | Factory Powertrain Limited Warranty or Federal Emissions Performance Warranty, for their components |
| 4 | Certified Pre-Owned Powertrain Warranty |
| 5 | Kessler Used Vehicle Limited Warranty |

A coverage lower in the table pays only where no coverage above it covers the same failure.

## Hypothetical cases

- A vehicle has an in-force Factory Basic Limited Warranty and an in-force Factory Powertrain Limited Warranty, and both cover a failed transmission. The Factory Basic Limited Warranty pays, and only its deductible applies.
- A vehicle has an in-force Factory Powertrain Limited Warranty and an in-force Certified Pre-Owned Powertrain Warranty, and both cover an engine failure. The Factory Powertrain Limited Warranty pays; the Certified Pre-Owned Powertrain Warranty's deductible does not apply.
- A failure is paid by none of the vehicle's in-force coverages. The work is customer pay or falls to a service contract under that product's own terms.
- A vehicle already has an active Factory Basic Limited Warranty. A second Factory Basic Limited Warranty cannot be registered on it.
